## Objective and atomic outcome

Determine from bounded known-truth synthetic evidence which geo-baseline and time-baseline family
should surround the pooled media response before retransformation, partial-pooling, replay, or
optimizer work. The target structure is:

```text
log(Y_gt) = geo_baseline_g + time_baseline_t + controls_gt + media_gt + error_gt
```

Produce one research certification report and, if needed, one machine-readable evidence archive.
This milestone does not implement production geo effects, time effects, retransformation, replay,
optimizer, economics, MIP, GeoX, Bayesian authority, or release thresholds.

## Bounded preregistered comparison matrix

Pre-register this matrix before empirical execution; do not expand it into an exhaustive Cartesian
product. Primary depth addresses the completed audit's direct findings: omitted geo baseline and
saturated time controls destroying national-media identification. Secondary variants are screened
using existing repository capabilities.

| Candidate | Primary purpose | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| A. Global intercept + pooled media + supplied controls | Current production reference | All required worlds |
| B. Geo effect + pooled media + supplied controls | Persistent geo baseline recovery | All required worlds |
| C. Geo effect + one bounded structured-time basis + pooled media + controls | Joint nuisance recovery | Smooth seasonality/trend primary; one event/shock screen |
| D. Geo effect + saturated week effects + pooled media | Identification stress comparator only | Near/exact-national worlds; never a production recommendation by RMSE |
| E. Regularized geo baseline | Shrinkage sensitivity only | Only if an existing implementation permits apples-to-apples evidence; otherwise unsupported |

Required coverage is bounded to existing H6/synthetic architecture: persistent geo baseline; geo
plus smooth trend/seasonality; abrupt common shocks; strongly geo-varying media; mixed national/local
media; near-national media; exact-national media; and sparse/short-history geos. Reuse existing
worlds first. Any additional world or harness path requires a new authorized owned path before
execution. Primary nuisance comparisons keep current plain Ridge level semantics and do not vary
retransformation, media pooling, optimizer settings, or Delta-mu authority. Structured-time screens
may use existing trend, Fourier, spline/knots, and known-event controls only.

## Required evidence and metrics

Measure with world IDs and seeds: geo/common-time baseline recovery; residual bias by geo/time;
residual variance; pooled beta and sign/contribution/lift recovery; full-panel Delta-mu recovery;
within-week variation ratio; rank/conditioning diagnostic; rank deficiency; coefficient instability;
sparse versus observed geo stability; nuisance stability across deterministic seeds/worlds; and
full-panel intervention compatibility with nuisance terms held fixed while intended media/control
dimensions change. Measure residual geo structure, time structure, heteroskedasticity, and serial
structure. Prediction error is secondary; candidate selection must jointly consider truth recovery,
identification, stability, degrees of freedom, residual contamination, and assumptions.

Explicitly demonstrate exact-national plus saturated-week non-identification, near-national behavior,
and that structured-time estimability relies on stronger time-path assumptions, not causal variation.
Do not call estimability causal identification.

No band authorizes production implementation or alters DR-04.
